components.name: API Gateway
components.quote: **API Gateway** (`cmd/api`): the public HTTP entry point for browsers and mobile apps.

components.name: Notifier
components.quote: **Notifier**: a service that emails customers when their order ships.

components.name: Orders
components.quote: **Orders**: the order domain logic, shared by the API Gateway and the Worker.

components.name: Payments
components.quote: **Payments**: charges customers when an order is fulfilled.

components.name: Store
components.quote: **Store**: the only module allowed to talk to the database.

components.name: Worker
components.quote: **Worker** (`cmd/worker`): a background process that fulfils orders.

relations.quote: The API Gateway calls Orders and Catalog in-process.
The API Gateway publishes order events to Kafka.
The API Gateway calls Orders and Catalog in-process.
The API Gateway must never access the Store directly; all persistence goes through Orders.
Catalog reads products from the Store.
Orders calls Payments to charge the customer.
Orders persists orders through the Store.
The Store is the only component that connects to PostgreSQL, using SQL.
The Worker calls the API Gateway over HTTP to fetch order details.
The Worker consumes order events from Kafka.
The Worker asks the Notifier over HTTP to email the customer.

The Worker opens a Store connection   and hands it
to Orders for fulfilment.
